approved_command_preview: Synchronize PR #545 with a live main that contains the merged #552 source anchor. Request 001 correctly failed because ChatGPT Exec progress-report commits advance main before the harness starts. This retry therefore guards that #552 merge SHA 44aa331 is an ancestor of live main instead of requiring main to equal that SHA. Preserve exact PR head, merge live main into the PR branch, require the intended four-file diff only, diff-check it, and push only the fast-forward merge commit. Do not merge PR #545, invoke DCOIR Review, request Copilot, or modify source outside the branch sync.
command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $expectedHead = '6684f278552d745d2bddf6a0b4d86c1652f0f29f'; $requiredMainAnchor = '44aa33130f04c61b51ffd298ec5beea097fa11a7'; $branch = 'codex/issue-466-native-writeback'; git fetch --no-tags origin "refs/heads/${branch}:refs/remotes/origin/${branch}" "refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'FETCH_FAILED' }; $remoteHead = (git rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/${branch}").Trim();
